lite_mode_info: Lite mode for stability, avoids changing system permissions.
window_logging_info: Disabling window logging may slightly reduce CPU usage.
smart_power_saver_info: Enables power saver when screen is off to save battery.
gapps_limiter_info: Limits GApps background activity using battery saver.
quick_launch_info: Preloads game APKs into RAM for faster launch.
allow_compaction_info: Compresses cached processes in RAM. (Requires Android 13+ & RAM Manager)
silent_trace_info: Disables miscellaneous/unused tracing to reduce CPU consumption for better gameplay.
use_trim_memory_info: Aggressively manages RAM by setting memory trim factor.
trim_memory_level_info: Simulates memory pressure to force apps to reduce RAM usage.
allow_whitelist_info: Exempts whitelisted apps from being force-stopped by RAM manager.
egl_preloader_info: Preloads EGL graphics libraries for a smoother UI. Choose which library to preload for EGL. 'System Library' forces the use of system drivers, while 'Game Native' uses the game's included libraries.
ram_manager_info: Automatically clears memory from unused processes.
ram_manager_exec_delay_info: Delay before RAM Manager executes its cleanup cycle.
ram_factor_info: Aggressive may kill multitasking apps. Safety is safer.
dnd_info: Enable Do Not Disturb while gaming.
device_group_info: bbk: For Realme/Oppo/Vivo. ubbk: For all other devices.
debug_info: Print detailed debugging logs to debug.log.
pararel_execution_conf_info: Execute custom scripts at different service events.
max_pararel_thread_info: Max number of custom scripts to run simultaneously (1-8).
pararel_dir_perf_info: Script(s) to run when 'Performance' profile is activated.
pararel_dir_close_info: Script(s) to run when 'Balanced' profile is activated.
pararel_dir_startup_info: Script(s) to run when the service starts.
pararel_dir_closeup_info: Script(s) to run when the service is uninstalled.
preload_size_limit_info: Max shader cache size. Format: 0=no limit, 512K, 256M, 1G. Type "auto" to let the system automatically determine the optimal size without risking crashes.
warning_ram_info: Triggers memory trim at this minimum RAM percentage.
critical_ram_info: Kills background apps at this minimum RAM percentage.
standby_info: If enabled, the WebUI server will not shut down automatically.
shutdown_time_info: Minutes of inactivity before server shuts down. (Disabled in Standby Mode)
speed_mode_info: Enable speed mode while gaming. Increases performance, high power consumption.
templimit_info: Disable temperature limit for better performance. May increase temps.
game_adj_info: Enable game adjustment for a boosted gaming experience.
bypass_temp_warn_info: Enable/disable high temperature warning for battery safety.
user_exp_info: Allow/disallow user experience features for a smoother UI.
fos_hdr_disabler_info: Enable or disable user HDR format. Disable for performance, enable for quality.
fos_network_acc_info: Enable or disable Vivo accelerated data network.
perf_enabler_info: Enable performance mode while gaming. High battery consumption.
temp_protect_info: Disable temperature limit while opening game.
dynamic_swap_info: Temporarily increases ZRAM usage ratio when RAM is low.
allowed_zram_used_info: The percentage amount of ZRAM that will be used temporarily.
icon_quality_info: increase or decrease icon reduce to free more ram on Launcher incrase to high detailed apps icon ( default is 100 )
icon_format_info: change the icon app format to decrase ram usage on default Launcher
launcher_warning_text: Experimental. May cause icon glitches or launcher crashes.
feat_airplane_info: Enables airplane mode when the device is idling in low power state to save battery.
feat_datasaver_info: Enables data saver mode when the device is idle to reduce background data usage.
feat_sensor_restrict_info: Restricts sensor access for GMS apps to save battery when device is idle in low power state.
preload_warning: Warning: may reboot if RAM is low
no_os_settings: No specific tunning available for your OS at the moment.
exit_confirmation_body: You have settings that require a reload. What would you like to do?
sched_boost_info: A kernel-level task scheduler optimization to improve UI responsiveness and reduce stuttering. May slightly increase battery consumption.
thermal_breaker_info: Aggressively attempts to bypass certain software-based thermal throttling limits. Use with caution, as this may lead to higher device temperatures.
game_list_desc: Select games to trigger the performance mode.
downscale_info: Lowers resolution to improve performance. 'Window' mode uses buffer scaling (recommended for Android 12-). Lower factor = worse quality.
downscale_mode_info: Select downscale method. 'Game Manager' changes internal resolution (Android 11+). 'Window Manager' scales screen buffer (Universal/Android 12-). 'Dual' enables both.
restart_daemon_desc: This will restart the service daemon to apply changes
cos_network_esport_mode_info: Enable WiFi low latency mode while gaming if the hardware supported.
cos_display_enchantment_info: Disable display sharpness enhancement if the display supported in game sessions.
allow_send_notification_info: Allow the script to send performance/balanced mode switch notifications.
hyperos_disable_thermal_info: Disable thermal when opening game and restore when game session ended.
smart_freezer_info: Freezing/defreezing background apps dynamically to save resource.
game_preloading_info: Preloads game assets and shaders into memory before launch for smoother startup.
